items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Yeah, we did something at the shrine, when Mrs. Miller was there, in the audience.

ctx.x: Not him? I think I have it written down in the other room, where this comes from, so we’ll have to look after we’re done. So you did some reunion things in the ‘80’s too, with the Miller band and Crosby?

In the 80’s. Yeah, we did something at the shrine, when Mrs. Miller was there, in the audience. And Ben Pollack was there. Billy May was conducting the orchestra. That’s when he had Micky McMickle was on that, and I think Ray Anthony too, and there was another trumpet guy.
